title: Verifier state space
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean input alphabet, a verifier state consists of a Boolean flag, an optional pair comprising an optional machine state and one of three head directions, a Boolean-valued function on the machine's $k$ tape indices, an optional-Boolean-valued function on those indices, and two further Boolean flags.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
